scope: source-data integrity and adapter smoke test only; no strategy signals, trade outcomes, or funded pass probability calculated
source: Dukascopy XAUUSD M5 BID/ASK GitHub Actions artifact #12031270051

cases: long entry uses ASK and mark uses BID low
short entry uses BID and mark uses ASK high
time/open exit is processed before new entry
favorable target gap is filled at target cap
missing M5 bar grid fails closed
wrong executable entry price fails closed
stop on wrong side of entry fails closed
adverse mark sorts before intrabar exit

limitations: This is not a strategy backtest or a FundedNext challenge replay.
The trade ledger must come from a separately frozen and reproducible strategy runner.
Added per-unit round-trip friction is charged from entry for conservative intratrade risk checks.
Broker/account commission, swap, contract-size conversion and exact server reset mapping still need verification.
Source adapter emits conservative adverse OHLC checkpoints; it cannot recover true tick order inside a candle.
